title: Hex casting Alternative lens
description: A really small resource pack that only changes texture of the lens in mod "Hex Casting" so it doesn't look weird when wearing it on your head
body: Just a small resource pack that changes the texture of the lens in Hex Casting mod. It's a simple change, but I find it pretty funny because I had to add this description. Im seriously, look at the gallery, there's only one screenshot with me wearing the lens
